name: hooks
description: Four projects are included - k8s: a kubernetes hook implementation that spins up pods dynamically to run a job, sharing the runner's workspace through a volume - k8s-novolume: a kubernetes hook implementation that spins up pods dynamically to run a job, copying the runner's workspace into the job pod instead of relying on a shared volume - docker: A hook implementation of the runner's docker implementation  - A hook lib, which contains shared typescript definitions and utilities that the other packages consume

scripts.test: npm run test --prefix packages/docker && npm run test --prefix packages/k8s && npm run test --prefix packages/k8s-novolume
scripts.bootstrap: npm ci --prefix packages/hooklib && npm ci --prefix packages/k8s && npm ci --prefix packages/k8s-novolume && npm ci --prefix packages/docker
scripts.build-all: npm run build --prefix packages/hooklib && npm run build --prefix packages/k8s && npm run build --prefix packages/k8s-novolume && npm run build --prefix packages/docker
